track: Track 2: The Agent That Can Explain Why
description: An autonomous multi-agent clinical supply chain resilience system that prevents catastrophic medicine stockouts through federated data auditing, deterministic zero-hallucination arithmetic, and competing hypothesis loops.

zetaris.implementation: app/adapters/data_store.py connects to Zetaris Lightning SQL REST API to query distributed facility ledgers, batches, deliveries, and external openFDA shortages in place.

engines_implemented.purpose: Headless shared canonical entity state across agents using content-derived stable IDs (ent_inv_*) and relational graph edges (HOLDS_INVENTORY, FOR_MEDICINE).
Hierarchical cross-session episodic memory tracking officer approvals, rejections, and penalties to dynamically tune action recommendations.

meterless.runtime: Meterless Nightshift AI Hotspot fallback in app/adapters/llm_client.py with required headers (meterless-app, meterless-scope)

nvidia.model: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b via NVIDIA NIM API in app/adapters/llm_client.py
